verdict.rationale: Docs indicate agents can autonomously search and access full codebase context via Projects and subagents (e.g., 'extensive codebase searches', context-aware agent, project-wide context) without requiring manual file selection, but there's no explicit description or demonstration of a 'map and explain the whole codebase' workflow, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this works well in practice. missing for 10: explicit codebase-mapping/summarization feature description, independent hands-on validation of accuracy on unfamiliar codebases.
